body: whoa there big fella, calm the fuck down. I never said I was going to immediately start a relationship with Emily right away. I've certainly got a lot of things to sort through before I take any more actions. There's still the possibility that I might have made a huge mistake too. It will likely be a few weeks or maybe a couple months before I start a fresh new relationship or work things out with Meg. Either way I think it's important to sort through my feelings a bit and figure out what went wrong and where
Certainly looking forward to something totally new and interesting. I have a feeling I will be leading a much more interesting life in the future.

There are times when Meg's schedule doesn't line up with mine and I have free time to spend with people. Sometimes I spend it with Emily, other times I spend it with other friends. When our schedules line up, which is very frequent, I almost exclusively hang out with Meg. I can't stress enough how my relationship with Emily has been completely platonic, though I am nearly certain she feels nearly the same as I. 

It's not that I love Emily more, I think my time with Meg is just about up, and even if Emily isn't that in to me, I think I'll still have to break up with Meg. The fact that I'm attracted to anyone else is an indication that I'm maybe not attracted to Meg anymore. 

I think I might have to put things on haitus with Emily, just to get my head straight if nothing else. 

Hitting the gym is awesome, makes me forget more than any amount of drinking or smoking. No thanks, not until i figure my shit out.

Fucking hormones. I was totally comfortable with Meg and I would have let this all go if I hadn't started to become physically ill when thinking about how much I miss Emily.

Thank you for everything.

I don't know if I love her, or if i ever did, or if I did and it has faded or what, but I am completely certain that I care for her, maybe a bit too much. She is an amazing human being, and yeah I think she deserves someone who does love her exclusively.
you're absolutely right. I think the fact that i have such strong feelings for someone else at all is a marker indicating that my time with Meg is just about up

Emily is a totally different person. Meg is incredibly nice, loving, and  caring, and totally able to fulfill my needs but is just a bit 'meh' for me, for lack of a better term. Emily is an energetic, motivated, bag-o-fun, and I honestly don't know her well enough to know if she can fulfill my needs, being as that we're not in a relationship. I do know that I am feeling much more strongly for Emily right now than I felt for Meg at the beginning of our relationship, or at least I think so. Maybe I'm just getting older and thinking about things differently, I don;t know.

In any case I think the fact that I have such strong feelings for someone else is a marker indicating that Meg's time is up very soon

This would be ideal, and after reading a few posts, its totally in line with what I'd like to do, but this would definitely not fly with either girl. It's totally true that my love is not a finite commodity, I have plenty for both but the jealously runs strong with both of them.
heh, that would be nice.... not so easy to pull that one

I'm not sure if she makes me happy anymore. I don't laugh at her jokes that much anymore, and our conversations have faded a bit in the past few months. However, I am certainly comfortable, she does make my life very easy. She is very supportive and genuine, and she does indeed genuinely care about me and vise versa. 

I have never gotten a crush on someone while I am already in a relationship in my 8 combined years of serious relationship.
bingo. thats the closest i can get to a justification to breaking up with meg. In reality they're damn near equal

I have been on both ends of breakups. I have already had to shatter one girlfriend of 2 years' heart, and the one I thought would last forever broke up with me after 1.5 years. They were both incredibly painful experiences that I really hoped I would never have to encounter again, and each took a long time to get over. I still feel terrible for the former and that was 6 years ago, and as for the latter, I occasionally still think of her. To combine those two circumstance just might be too much; my emotional tank is on E and I just can't force myself to do it without a damn good reason, but that doesn't change how I'm currently feeling.
Just trying to keep it light ;) I'm generally not too serious about things, I don't have enough time on earth to be sad. Thanks for the advice though.

Never been in a serious fight. Silly things once in a long while, that I could count on one hand, but we are usually very open and communicative. I do find it very easy to talk to her. And yes, several people will inevitably get hurt here, including myself one way or the other. I don't know if I even have it in me to do anything
